hypothesis: Add heldout-gated likelihood refinement to SeqFlow preparation: after the Parent-identical four-epoch training prefix, continue the same corpus-only likelihood optimization for four bounded epochs and publish the checkpoint with the lowest deterministic heldout active-block latent NLL, retaining epoch four as the safe fallback.
method_thesis: Train a task-agnostic autoregressive normalizing flow on corpus-only SELFIES so that each discrete molecule has a continuous token-latent encoding whose left-inverse reconstructs that same sequence. In each fresh objective session, encode the oracle-evaluated molecules, fit a task-local Gaussian-process surrogate to their latent codes and observed scores, and center local trust regions on high-scoring evaluated anchors. Generate a new ephemeral candidate pool each round by uniformly choosing latent-token blocks to perturb inside those regions, inverse-decode the perturbed points, and locally reject invalid, previously evaluated, or duplicate molecules before using posterior Thompson samples to choose the announced batch. Returned scores update the surrogate, anchors, and trust-region state. The corpus supplies only representation learning: no corpus molecule is retrieved, ranked, or treated as a fixed candidate, and every oracle proposal is a newly decoded de novo molecule selected to raise terminal Top-1.

method_tags.acquisition_mechanism: Gaussian-process posterior Thompson selection over a freshly generated trust-region candidate pool
method_tags.learning_mechanism: offline corpus-only SeqFlow training plus a task-local latent Gaussian process fit only to oracle-evaluated molecule-score pairs
method_tags.proposal_mechanism: evaluated-anchor trust-region perturbation of latent token blocks followed by inverse-flow de novo decoding
method_tags.representation: SELFIES token sequences mapped to an exactly reconstructible continuous latent space by an autoregressive normalizing flow

activation_observables.measurement: On the existing deterministic 512-molecule heldout corpus split, evaluate zero-dequantization SeqFlow negative log likelihood per active BOS/SELFIES/EOS block, including the standard-normal constant and excluding only padded positions. Record the epoch-4 checkpoint reached by the Parent-identical training prefix, the value after each of four continuation epochs, and the published checkpoint. Report the per-seed and three-seed mean selected-minus-epoch-4 change; activation requires the selected checkpoint to come from an epoch after four and to have lower heldout latent NLL, while the exact round-trip gate remains a mandatory supporting check.

applicability_conditions: The Parent's four-epoch training prefix must remain deterministic under the supplied preparation seed so its epoch-4 checkpoint is an exact within-run reference before refinement begins.

The fixed heldout split must be large enough for active-block latent NLL to distinguish continued generalization from training-loss improvement; it remains corpus-only and never contains task identity or oracle scores.
Lower heldout latent NLL must preserve the exact zero-perturbation token and canonical round trip, because likelihood improvement cannot replace the frozen representation admission gate.

The mechanism can help when the Parent stops before its corpus likelihood has converged and a more regular heldout latent density gives the frozen surrogate and perturbation consumers a better geometry; it need not help if epoch four is already optimal or likelihood is unrelated to objective smoothness.

Four additional epochs must fit within the supplied preparation timeout and memory profile; the epoch-4 state remains the bounded fallback if every continuation checkpoint has worse or non-finite heldout NLL.

This intervention does not revisit the Knowledge-only intervention-weighted block-sampling cluster c-5d13b8b06f or the dispatch-repair cluster c-b4d6bbfb3c: block selection remains uniform and collision-safe _flow_params dispatch is retained unchanged.
research_intent.falsifier: The mechanism did not activate if no finite continuation checkpoint after epoch four has lower deterministic heldout active-block latent NLL than the Parent-identical epoch-4 checkpoint, or if the published state is not the recorded minimum-NLL checkpoint. Any loss of exact heldout token or canonical reconstruction also falsifies the usable representation mechanism; lower NLL with unchanged or worse benchmark score would instead mean it activated without task utility.
research_intent.implementation_change: Keep corpus sampling, vocabulary, codebook, architecture, dequantization, optimizer, batch order, loss, and the first four training epochs byte-for-byte behaviorally identical to the Parent. At epoch four, compute deterministic zero-noise active-block heldout latent NLL and retain that state. Continue the same optimizer for exactly four additional epochs, measure the same heldout NLL after each epoch without consuming RNG, retain only the finite minimum-NLL state with deterministic earlier-epoch tie breaking, reload it before the existing exact round-trip gate, and emit the paired epoch-4 and selected-checkpoint diagnostic. Leave the two-file artifact interface and every online Layer unchanged.

research_intent.observed_bottleneck: Parent node n-5e9392f126c0 proves that all three independently trained SeqFlow artifacts load and reconstruct exactly, yet that binary gate leaves latent-density quality uncontrolled: preparation unconditionally publishes the fourth epoch without measuring heldout latent NLL, while the resulting macro score varies from 0.441893056926007 to 0.531102062096459 (standard deviation 0.04100326143244739) and drd2_docking alone has standard deviation 0.14883935107026078. The limiting behavior addressed here is fixed-horizon termination with no corpus-generalization criterion, not the already repaired affine dispatch or exactness.

applicability_conditions: The confirmed activation applies to the observed fixed corpus split procedure, inherited 98-by-12 SeqFlow representation, unchanged AdamW likelihood training, preparation seeds 0 through 2, and four continuation epochs after the deterministic Parent-equivalent epoch-4 state.

The Parent-prefix assumption is supported for all three observed seeds: corpus size, vocabulary size, and every epoch-1-through-4 training-loss diagnostic match the corresponding Parent receipt exactly, and heldout evaluation begins only after the fourth epoch without sampling noise or RNG use.

Every observed continuation checkpoint had finite heldout NLL and improved on epoch four, and epoch eight was the strict minimum on all seeds. The evidence therefore supports continued-likelihood refinement where the Parent stops before heldout likelihood converges; it does not demonstrate fallback behavior where continuation is worse or non-finite.

The usable representation condition is supported across three independently prepared artifacts: all heldout gates were exactly 512/512 in token and canonical space, and every one of the fifteen downstream sessions loaded the two-file artifact and maintained exact admitted-example reconstruction.

The implementation remains preparation-local and corpus-only: the selector receives heldout token tensors and lengths, not task identity or oracle scores, while uniform online block selection, collision-safe _flow_params dispatch, surrogate fitting, trust-region updates, inverse-decode filtering, and Thompson selection remain inherited.

The evidence supports lower heldout latent NLL and interface compatibility, but not transfer to benchmark utility: all three paired val_scores decreased, with mean change -0.07334922775267033. This adverse score evidence does not alter the confirmed activation decision and does not by itself isolate whether objective smoothness, proposal productivity, or another downstream interaction caused the utility loss.
